tagline: A thousand years of history inside a scooter swarm — the Old Quarter's guild streets, Hoan Kiem's legendary turtle, and a train that squeezes through homes.
overview: Hanoi has been Vietnam's capital for most of a thousand years, and it layers every era: the 36 guild streets of the Old Quarter, French-colonial boulevards, Soviet-era blocks and the incense-hazed temples of Hoan Kiem lake.

The city's famous images are real: scooters flowing like water, cafes spilling onto sidewalks, and the train that squeezes twice daily through Train Street's narrow homes while cafés pull back their tables. Dawn belongs to tai chi and street-side pho by the lake.

Speed's 2024 stream captured the signature chaos — scooter swarms, street food and walls of fans. Beyond the centre, the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum complex and the Temple of Literature hold the country's founding memory.

funFacts.title: A THOUSAND-YEAR CAPITAL
funFacts.text: Hanoi was founded in 1010 — it celebrated its millennium in 2010.

funFacts.title: 36 GUILD STREETS
funFacts.text: Old Quarter lanes were each named for a trade — Silk Street, Silver Street, Bamboo Street.

funFacts.title: TRAIN STREET
funFacts.text: A railway squeezes through a 2-metre alley — cafés pull tables back twice a day.

funFacts.title: THE RETURNED SWORD
funFacts.text: Hoan Kiem means 'Lake of the Returned Sword' — a legendary turtle reclaimed a hero's blade.

funFacts.title: PHO'S BIRTHPLACE
funFacts.text: Vietnam's national dish was born on these streets — breakfast pho remains a religion.

funFacts.title: EIFFEL'S BRIDGE
funFacts.text: Long Bien Bridge was designed by Gustave Eiffel's firm and survived the war.

funFacts.title: WATER PUPPETS
funFacts.text: Thang Long theatre keeps up a 1,000-year-old art performed in flooded rice paddies.

funFacts.title: A SCOOTER OCEAN
funFacts.text: Motorbikes vastly outnumber cars — crossing the road is a learned faith.

funFacts.title: THE FIRST UNIVERSITY
funFacts.text: Van Mieu, Vietnam's first university (1070), still holds its stone doctorate stelae on tortoises.

funFacts.title: EGG COFFEE
funFacts.text: Hanoi invented coffee whisked with egg yolk — born when milk was scarce.
